plugin.schema.json and mcp.schema.json are copied unmodified from the Agent Plugins
specification, schemas/1.0.0/, at commit ff8ab5e392cc87bd88d87c060815a87490e51003
(https://github.com/agentplugins/agent-plugins-spec, read 2026-10-03). Schemas are licensed under the
Apache License 2.0 (LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt here). They are copied so the plugin test
validates offline: the spec forbids fetching a schema while loading a plugin.
